description: Contractual-pin -> latest Hermes capability delta with Qubit counterpart classification and an adapter plan. Pin-based; no product source or manifest was modified to produce this file.

latest_main.note: moving ref; brief recorded 5bb314fa0148a9879123770a609dab8f87f03fc9, which is 5 commits behind the live head and now superseded

resolution_method: git ls-remote (network live) + local pinned clone at /tmp/opencode/pinned/hermes-agent; commit counts via GitHub compare API because the local clone is shallow
unverified_refs: latest_main recorded in docs/QUBIT_ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BRIEF_2026-09-21.md as 5bb314fa0148a9879123770a609dab8f87f03fc9 is superseded by live bb359ec5c1d5da6a66f00ee11f0ad7a86defaee2 (5 commits ahead).

Brief states '72 vendored-fork top-level CLI families'; measured add_parser-derived families are 66 (pin), 67 (release), 69 (main). The 72 figure uses a different counting method (likely includes chat/serve/agent and plugin-registered families).
Local pinned clone is shallow (grafted roots); pin->release/main ancestry and commit counts could not be computed locally and were taken from the GitHub compare API.
Optional-skill SKILL.md files were enumerated by path, not semantically diffed.
Per-provider plugin modifications were enumerated by name; their internal contract deltas were not read line-by-line.
